tasks.title: Install lightweight AI-first harness baseline
tasks.notes: Adds the AGENTS routing file, structured task state, methodology docs, design-doc/ADR index, first product spec, single make verify gate, and CI workflow. Phase-specific smokes are intentionally deferred until product code exists.

tasks.title: Scaffold Python package and Phase 0 contract validation
tasks.notes: Added the folio Python package scaffold, Pydantic v2 contract.yaml validation, ten contract pytest cases, the python-test target, and CI uv sync wiring so make verify is reproducible across environments.

tasks.title: Implement Phase 0 core operations on records.jsonl
tasks.notes: Added the Sheet class with get_contract, query (DuckDB SELECT-only), list_records (with pagination cursor and field projection), get_record, upsert_records, and delete_records. Writes go through atomic temp-file-plus-rename and acquire .lock with a 30s timeout via filelock. editable_by patterns are matched with fnmatch.

tasks.title: Add the folio CLI MVP
tasks.notes: Added the Typer-based folio CLI with validate, query, list, count, upsert, and delete, registered as a project script (folio = folio.cli:main), plus 16 CliRunner tests and a deterministic scripts/smoke-cli.sh that exercises the §23.3 scenario from the design overview.

tasks.title: Expand ADR coverage for Phase 0 design choices
tasks.notes: Added seven accepted ADRs anchoring the Phase 0 design choices encoded in the SDK and CLI: Python as reference implementation, ODCS subset, JSONL records, DuckDB SELECT-only queries, single-writer .lock, fnmatch-based editable_by, and cache/runtime placement outside the sheet. Each ADR's Confirmation names a make verify check.

tasks.title: Phase 1 product spec and backlog
tasks.notes: Recorded the Phase 1 executable spec (derivations, materialize, provenance, cache, CLI verbs, verification expectations, reference scenario) and registered four implementation tasks FOLIO-H-009 through FOLIO-H-012 to keep loops bounded.

tasks.title: Implement Phase 1 derivation parsing and import kind
tasks.notes: Added Pydantic v2 models for derivations/<field>.yaml using a kind-discriminated union (AIDerivation, ImportDerivation), MaterializationConfig defaults, prompt vs prompt_ref XOR, output/output_schema correspondence enforcement for ai kind, value_field vs value_fields XOR for import kind, load_derivation/load_derivations/detect_cycles/topological_sort, and an import-kind execution helper covering CSV/JSONL/JSON with sheet-relative path enforcement.

tasks.title: Implement Phase 1 cache key and provenance
tasks.notes: Added compute_input_hash via RFC 8785 with sha256: prefix, sha256_hex / sha256_file helpers, the user-cache-rooted default_cache_root (per ADR-0008), shard-prefixed cache_path / read_cache / write_cache, and the append-only provenance.jsonl helpers (append_provenance, read_provenance, latest_provenance, field_history, is_stale).

tasks.title: Implement Phase 1 ai kind via the Anthropic SDK
tasks.notes: Added the ai kind driver as a pure function over an AIClient Protocol with AnthropicClientAdapter for production and StubAIClient for tests; the {{ field }} template expansion; text/json single-target and multi-target parsing with output_schema enforcement; a per-model price table; and ADR-0009 anchoring the Protocol+Adapter+Stub design.

tasks.title: Add Phase 1 CLI verbs and materialize smoke
tasks.notes: Wired Sheet.materialize / Sheet.materialization_status / Sheet.provenance with the §10.6 envelope, dependency-ordered iteration over derivation files, cache short-circuiting, respect_human_override, force, atomic records-then-provenance writes, and failures-as-list. Added folio materialize, folio status, and folio provenance CLI verbs plus a deterministic scripts/smoke-materialize.sh that walks the §23.3 scenario through StubAIClient.

tasks.title: Phase 2 product spec and backlog
tasks.notes: Recorded the Phase 2 spec for reusable scripts/ runtime and README YAML frontmatter, and registered FOLIO-H-014 / FOLIO-H-015 implementation tasks.

tasks.title: Implement Phase 2 scripts/ runtime
tasks.notes: Added discover_scripts / run_script with .py and .sh dispatch, sheet-path-as-argv[1], safe-name regex, optional venv creation under runtime_root_for_sheet (ADR-0008), Sheet.run_script, folio script list / run subcommands, and the scripts-smoke gate.

tasks.title: Implement Phase 2 README frontmatter
tasks.notes: Added Pydantic v2 Frontmatter model with required purpose / default_actor and optional tags / links / agent_skills, parse_frontmatter / load_readme_metadata helpers, Sheet.metadata lazy property, and folio validate enhancement that surfaces frontmatter problems as warnings by default and as errors with --strict.

tasks.title: Phase 3 product spec and backlog
tasks.notes: Recorded the Phase 3 spec for the MCP server (FastMCP) and TOON output, and registered FOLIO-H-017 / FOLIO-H-018 implementation tasks.

tasks.title: Implement Phase 3 MCP server
tasks.notes: Added the folio-mcp sibling package with build_server exposing the nine SDK operations as FastMCP tools (with when-to-use docstrings), sheet-path resolution against --root with traversal rejection, AIClient injection for materialize, the folio-mcp serve CLI (stdio + http), in-process Client tests, and a deterministic scripts/smoke-mcp.sh harness wired into make verify.

tasks.title: Implement Phase 3 TOON output
tasks.notes: Added a thin TOON encoder ([N]{cols}: header + comma-delimited rows, trivial scalars unquoted, JSON-encoded otherwise), plumbed format='json' | 'toon' through Sheet.list_records and folio list --format, and pinned the encoded shape in tests/test_toon.py.

tasks.title: Phase 4 product spec and backlog
tasks.notes: Recorded the Phase 4 spec for extension derivation kinds (sql / http / python / cross_sheet) plus datapackage.json generation, and registered FOLIO-H-020 / FOLIO-H-021 / FOLIO-H-022 implementation tasks.

tasks.title: Implement Phase 4 sql and http extension kinds
tasks.notes: Extended the discriminated derivation union with SQLDerivation (DuckDB SELECT-only expression with parameter passthrough; records.jsonl hash folds into input_hash; cache bypassed) and HTTPDerivation (templated URL/body, response_path/response_schema dot-path, HTTPTransport Protocol with HTTPXTransport adapter and StubHTTPTransport for offline tests). Added compute_input_hash extra_components passthrough, Sheet.materialize sql + http branches, and the extension-kinds-smoke gate.

tasks.title: Implement Phase 4 python and cross_sheet kinds
tasks.notes: Added PythonDerivation (calls Sheet.run_script with JSON-encoded inputs as argv[2]; text/json output parsing matches the ai kind) and CrossSheetDerivation (resolves a sibling sheet by relative path, matches the foreign records.jsonl row by primary key, folds the foreign records hash into the input_hash). Sheet.materialize gains the matching dispatch branches and cache integration.

tasks.title: Implement Phase 4 datapackage.json generation
tasks.notes: Added build_descriptor / write_datapackage that map a Folio contract to a Frictionless v1 descriptor per §14.2 (logicalType -> Frictionless type, single primaryKey, propagated descriptions, required constraints, folioDerived flag). folio export datapackage CLI writes <sheet>/datapackage.json or pipes to stdout.

tasks.title: Phase 5 product spec and backlog
tasks.notes: Recorded the Phase 5 spec for the local-only Viewer aligned with §19's V0..V6 stages, and registered FOLIO-H-024 / FOLIO-H-025 implementation tasks.

tasks.title: Implement Phase 5 Viewer V0-V3
tasks.notes: Added the FastAPI Viewer backend (folio-viewer console script) with REST routes for contract / records / get_record / query / status / materialize / provenance, CSRF token plumbing on every mutating verb, and graceful FolioError mapping. Vite + React + TanStack Table scaffold under viewer/ implements V0..V3 (records grid, type chips, x-editable-by inline editor, provenance hover with derivation badges). 18 pytest cases plus scripts/smoke-viewer.sh boot uvicorn on a random port and round-trip the API. drift-check now pins fastapi / uvicorn imports to src/folio_viewer/.

tasks.title: Implement Phase 5 Viewer V4-V6
tasks.notes: Added the in-process EventBus and /events SSE endpoint that publishes materialize.start / materialize.end / materialize.error frames around Sheet.materialize, the Dashboard.tsx and History.tsx React views, the useEventStream hook, and the folio serve CLI alias that lazy-imports folio_viewer.cli to keep drift-check's viewer-only invariant. The smoke now opens an SSE consumer thread before triggering materialize and asserts the lifecycle frames arrive. Playwright config + a lightweight grid spec are scaffolded under viewer/tests/ and documented as opt-in (Node toolchain is intentionally not wired into make verify).

tasks.title: Add semantic ADR-to-code drift checks
tasks.notes: Added validate_adr_anchored_invariants in harness_drift.py: anthropic must be imported only in _ai_kind.py (ADR-0009); duckdb (ADR-0005) and filelock (ADR-0006) must each be imported somewhere under src/folio/; tests/fixtures sheets must not bundle .cache / .venv / .folio-cache / .folio-runtime per ADR-0008.

tasks.title: Redesign Viewer per Claude Design handoff
tasks.notes: Re-implemented the Viewer frontend against the Claude Design (claude.ai/design) handoff bundle: integrated single-view layout (QueryBar → grid + right panel), unified query bar (WHERE clauses or DuckDB SELECT in one input, with a resizable Result/History/Schema drawer), Sheets-flavored grid with sticky header, inline cell editor (Enter to commit, Esc to cancel) for x-editable-by fields, click-to-select rows with bulk delete, click derived header → Inspector tab, hover any cell for the provenance pop, and a 3-tab right panel (Schema · Activity · Inspector) with a persistent rail. Materialize lifecycle SSE frames are folded into the activity feed and pulse the cells that just filled. Backend addition: materialization_status now returns derivation_kind + per-kind counts (python/sql/http/cross_sheet) so the UI can color the per-target dot.
